recent_findings.topic: Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness do not stack their armor reduction
recent_findings.assessment: Minor armor debuffs compete rather than adding their reductions.

recent_findings.topic: Instant Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning carry a no-swing-reset attribute
recent_findings.assessment: Instant Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning preserve swings; hardcasts still defer melee.

recent_findings.topic: Divine Precision includes Holy Strike, not every Holy attack
recent_findings.assessment: Divine Precision includes the sourced Holy Strike family, not all Holy attacks.

recent_findings.topic: Holy Strike player-SP scaling is reportedly multiplied by its weapon percentage
recent_findings.assessment: Holy Strike player SP uses the sourced weapon percentage; target bonus SP is kept separate.

recent_findings.topic: Weapon-racial crit exclusion has stronger ranged Auto Shot evidence
recent_findings.assessment: Additional ranged-auto racial crit observations narrow an existing question but do not justify a generic crit change.

recent_findings.topic: Pet Dust Cloud probably shares the minor armor category; further pet-debuff stacking is unproven
recent_findings.assessment: Dust Cloud sharing a minor armor category is credible partial evidence; other pet-debuff stacking is not established.

recent_findings.topic: Revelation creates a pet/periodic crit loophole in the current beta
recent_findings.assessment: A reported Revelation pet/periodic crit exploit is not a supported build recipe or verified intended mechanic.

recent_findings.topic: Touch of the Grave benefits from Shadow damage modifiers
recent_findings.assessment: Touch of the Grave already follows its Shadow modifiers.

recent_findings.topic: Mage Spirit regeneration matches the old formula above50Spirit
recent_findings.assessment: Mage Spirit reports corroborate the existing higher-Spirit formula; lower-Spirit observations are not a level-60 recalibration.

recent_findings.topic: Arcane Missiles has per-missile hit/crit rolls; the claimed damage bank is not demonstrated
recent_findings.assessment: Arcane Missiles already rolls hit/crit per missile; a claimed banked-damage script remains unproved.

recent_findings.topic: Seal of Command player/target SP placement already matches the reported distinction
recent_findings.assessment: Seal of Command player/target SP placement already matches the supported distinction.

recent_findings.topic: Seal of Righteousness20%/22% SP table is not a new discrepancy by itself
recent_findings.assessment: The reported Seal of Righteousness coefficient table does not establish a new defect.

recent_findings.topic: Retribution Aura13.57% SP is a proposed coefficient, not a measured one
recent_findings.assessment: The proposed reactive-aura SP coefficient is not a controlled measurement.

recent_findings.topic: Real-item proc rates differ from Era;100% wrappers do not prove100% effective procs
recent_findings.assessment: Real-item wrappers do not establish effective proc rates. The hypothetical fixed-stat catalog does not acquire those effects.

recent_findings.topic: Creature-type damage racials may or may not carry a hidden crit multiplier
recent_findings.assessment: A hidden creature-type racial crit multiplier remains unverified.

recent_findings.topic: Consume stacking discussion does not establish new Forever rules
recent_findings.assessment: Classic consume-stacking recollection is not a new Forever rule.

recent_findings.topic: Low-level Warrior dodge observations corroborate Defense skill accounting
recent_findings.assessment: Low-level dodge reports support Defense accounting, not a new max-level avoidance calibration.

recent_findings.topic: Shield attacks and Dual Wield Specialization discussion is not a new Forever test
recent_findings.assessment: Shield/dual-wield discussion does not supply a new controlled Forever test.

recent_findings.topic: AP coefficients and Ice Lance overrides are still explicitly provisional
recent_findings.assessment: Missing server coefficients remain qualified; no inferred Ice Lance override is added.

recent_findings.topic: Fresh upstream implementation leads are inaccessible, not validated imports
recent_findings.assessment: Unavailable upstream implementations are access gaps, not validated imports.

limitations: This is complete point coverage, not proof that every described spell or pet family is implemented.
Announced next-build talent changes retain separate source/version qualifications.
Private chat text, identities, message metadata and raw media are not included.
Flametongue has exclusions but lacks a supported numeric damage/script rule; SHA-006 contains the test prerequisites.

additional_corrections.assessment: Forever direct hits add 0.005 current AP before ordinary damage multipliers; Classic remains unchanged. Deadly tick/stack placement remains ROG-002.
